dialogue.text: You still don't understand. You see my ruin, but not the reason.
Understand what?! What are you even doing?!
PJ... something's wrong. The ground is gone. The air... it feels... empty. So cold.
I am showing you everything! The loneliness... the darkness... before there was anything but ME!
Holy shit... Is this... The Void?
I... I can't feel anything. It's just... nothingness.
Precisely. Now... you will feel what I felt. Let us begin.
